import json

TICK_TO_LOG = 42
LOG_SCRIPT_PATH = "storage/telos/log_actions.py"

    {"type": "meta", "target": "self", "metadata": {"action": "update"}},
    {"type": "submit", "target": "1", "metadata": {"eval_id": 94, "title": "AOS Tactical Layer: First Live Use of Experiment Manager"}}
]

actions_json_string = json.dumps(actions_to_log)
command = ["python", LOG_SCRIPT_PATH, str(TICK_TO_LOG), actions_json_string]
subprocess.run(command, check=True)
